import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static int[] ver = new int[1001000];
    static int[] po = new int[1001000];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int p = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int r = 1;

        if (k == 0) {
            for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
                r = (int)((1L * r * p) % MOD);
            }
            System.out.println(r);
            return;
        }
        if (k == 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < p; ++i) {
                r = (int)((1L * r * p) % MOD);
            }
            System.out.println(r);
            return;
        }

        po[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 1000000; ++i) {
            po[i] = (int)((1L * po[i - 1] * k) % p);
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
            if (ver[i] == 0) {
                int j = i;
                int l = 0;
                do {
                    ver[j] = 1;
                    ++l;
                    j = (int)((1L * k * j) % p);
                } while (ver[j] == 0);

                if (po[l] == 1) {
                    r = (int)((1L * r * p) % MOD);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(r);
        sc.close();
    }
}
